A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is a significant accumulation of cadmium, lead and chromium in soils irrigated with raw municipal wastewaters, which could represent a risk for human health.
the soils of DR03 are affected by the application of wastewater, but there is not an immediate risk of contamination of agricultural products with the species analyzed in this work.
